# Free Screen Studio Alternative: OpenScreen (No Watermarks)

OpenScreen is a free, open-source Screen Studio alternative: no watermarks, no subscription, 100% commercial use. Now trending on GitHub.

Every demo creator has hit the same wall: a beautiful recording, then a watermark you can't remove without paying. OpenScreen — a free, open-source Screen Studio alternative — just solved that, for free, forever, with no strings attached. [...] OpenScreen is a demo creation tool (software that records your screen and converts interactions into polished walkthroughs, product tours, or sales videos). Think onboarding guides, investor demos, or documentation walkthroughs — the kind of content that typically requires Screen Studio or an expensive SaaS (cloud subscription software) alternative like Loom or Arcade.

What the project delivers out of the box: [...] Watermarks on free exports — your demo looks amateur until you upgrade
 Subscription fatigue — recurring monthly fees for a tool you use occasionally
 Commercial use ambiguity — unclear licensing rights for agency or client deliverables
 Vendor dependency — your entire workflow breaks if their servers go down
 No self-hosting option — you can't deploy or fork the tool to your own infrastructure

OpenScreen eliminates all five. The project's own description puts it plainly: "Create stunning demos for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use."
